For the current regular TEJ classroom route, use the independent [Linux, networking, GitHub Pages, sensors, modelling and Raspberry Pi modules](../linux/index.qmd). These can be arranged differently for each implementation. The CS01-CS08 sequence below remains a hardware-service reference and is **not** the prerequisite sequence for every student. Optional repair, multimeter and upgrade labs live in the [Engineering Preparation Track lab directory](../engineering-preparation-track/labs/index.qmd).

::: {.callout-note title="Current classroom missions"}
Circuit calculations remain required weekly work, but the immediate priority is deploying a first approved batch of Linux machines for TAS. [Computer Power and Parts](computer-power-parts.qmd) is a future hardware lab shell. Teacher-assigned students may complete the [Computer Recovery and OS Comparison](computer-recovery-crew-pilot.qmd); approved early finishers may select [Make It Print](make-it-print.qmd).
:::

![A desktop-computer cutaway showing the sealed power supply, motherboard, CPU, RAM, storage, expansion slots, and fan.](/assets/tej/Computer_System_Cutaway.svg){width=92%}

::: {.callout-important title="Hardware safety boundary"}
Never open or probe inside a power supply. Power off and unplug before changing hardware. Students never create shorts or invent faults. The teacher prepares every fault station.
:::
